session_notes: Troubled session: URL import attempt (404 error), CTR record lost after save, Mean value used as threshold (B2 exclusion applies). Wrong target attempts. Train→test switch at session end. No audio.

B2.note: Mean value line used as threshold in one model. Per Section 3.3 B2 exclusion: 'CODAP fixed statistical lines (Mean value, Median, Percentile) do not constitute a movable value under B2-A1.' That instance excluded. Remaining threshold behavior was non-iterative. Acquire/Low.

B3.note: Fat dragged as target in first attempt, then corrected. B3-A1 confirmed.
